text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Thou hast done well.
Speak thy desired reward.
choice_data_list: Just knowing you had fun is enough for me.
As long as you had fun, that's more than enough.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I forbid it.
What kind of king bestows no grace worthy of the title?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: "Anything will do. I shall give it to you... Come now."
